description: PySCF DF-ROHF orbitals (spherical, conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-9, internally stable) for each df_rohf.json case and for one-electron cases of its own (no beta electron), which also carry df_rohf.json's keys: total energy (hartree), mo_energy, and mo_coeff and the overlap in the tree's unrenormalized functions, n x n column-major
